cover_letter_text:
Hi Chalouhi team,

I'm Marc. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. Your advert says recent graduates are strongly encouraged to apply, so here I am.

On site in the Philippines, from April 2019 to February 2020, I checked drawings against the work, did site inspections and quality checks, coordinated crews and wrote the site and progress reports. I also use AutoCAD and Civil 3D.

I'd move to Sydney and can start two weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), a White Card and a full Victorian driver's licence. Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
advert_text:
Chalouhi is a leading civil engineering, demolition, and construction company. We are known for delivering complex infrastructure, excavation and basement projects across the Sydney Metro region. Our reputation is built on innovation, expertise, and a strong commitment to quality, safety, and sustainability.
We’re more than just a civil construction company, we’re a team of problem-solvers, collaborators, and career-builders. At Chalouhi, we don’t just deliver projects, we empower people to grow, lead, and make a lasting impact.
About the Role
Due to continued project growth, Chalouhi is seeking a Site Engineer to support the delivery of a diverse range of demolition works across the Sydney Metro area.
These roles offer an exciting opportunity to work on high-profile projects while developing your career in a fast-paced and supportive environment.
Key Responsibilities
 - Coordinate and support day-to-day engineering and site activities
 - Assist with the planning and delivery of demolition, excavation and enabling works
 - Review and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and programs
 - Ensure works are delivered in accordance with design, safety, quality, and environmental standards
 - Manage and maintain technical documentation including RFIs, ITPs, and as-built records
 - Work closely with subcontractors, suppliers, consultants, and internal stakeholders
 - Monitor progress against construction schedules and assist with cost tracking
 - Conduct site inspections and support issue resolution
 - Promote compliance with HSEQ systems and best practices
 - Assist in the identification and implementation of process improvements
What We're Looking For
 - Degree in Civil Engineering or related field
 - 1–2 years’ experience in demolition, excavation, civil construction or related projects
 - Recent graduates are strongly encouraged to apply 
 - Exposure to demolition, basement, excavation or infrastructure projects 
 - Solid understanding of construction methodologies and standards
 - Strong problem-solving, communication, and organisational skills
 - Ability to interpret technical documentation and manage field-based tasks
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with AutoCAD, Aconex or similar systems is advantageous
 - White Card and valid driver’s licence
Why Join Chalouhi – The Foundation For Potential
 - Work on landmark projects across Sydney 
 - Clear career development and growth pathways
 - Great Place to Work Certified 2026–2027
 - Supportive and inclusive team culture focused on collaboration
 - Access to employee benefits including EAP and ongoing training
 - Opportunities to lead, innovate, and make a lasting impact
